Subject: AWS listing — request for technical evidence + co-sell materials

Hi Aisha,

Thanks again for the walkthrough last week. We're getting internal momentum to list a proof-of-concept of the Acme analytics integration on the AWS Marketplace and the field team asked for the following so they can complete the intake and co-sell handoff: 

- Technical evidence pack (SOC 2 summary, data flow diagram, encryption/KMS notes)
- AMI/OCI image screenshot and seller-id for the listing
- A short co-sell playbook the field can use (1-pager + 20-min demo script)
- Any product-page blurb & bullets you recommend for the AWS product page

Can you share what you have today and approximate ETA? We need to get intake to procurement by end of next week.

Also, is a Private Offer required for the configuration we discussed? Tom from our CloudOps will be on the thread in case we need to share image details.

Appreciate it,
Sophie
Sophie Grant
Head of Cloud Partnerships, Acme Analytics

Thanks Sophie — great to see this move forward. Quick status and plan: 

1) Technical evidence pack: attached is our working pack (redwood-tech-evidence-v1.pdf). It includes SOC 2 scope statement, data flow diagrams for hosted vs dedicated deployments, and KMS/HSM notes. It is a summary document suitable for procurement and Marketplace intake (can expand to full artifacts on request).

2) AMI/seller info: attaching a screenshot of the AMI seller console (ami-screenshot-20270607.png) and the seller-id is included in the evidence pack. For the SKU mapping we typically suggest one SKU for Hosted API and one for Dedicated (we'll propose sample usage tiers).

3) Co-sell playbook: draft attached (co-sell-playbook-draft.docx). Ben — can you review the 20-min demo script and field scripting? Marissa — can you validate the one-liner and bullets for product page copy (I included a first pass below)?

Suggested AWS product page blurb (first pass):
Redwood Inference — high-throughput LLM inference platform for predictable latency and cost.
Top bullets:
- Hosted API, Dedicated pools, and VPC/private deployment options
- Transparent performance & token-level cost breakdowns
- Built-in rollout and fallback policies for reliability

If a Private Offer is required for the configuration you described (customer-managed VPC + dedicated capacity), it is common but not strictly required — we can proceed with a standard listing and enable private offer on the backend if you need contract-level pricing.

Next steps I propose: I will send the pack now; internal review from Kimberly/Ben/Marissa today; final package to you tomorrow morning. Can we schedule a 30-min field enablement call Thurs 6/10 or Fri 6/11?

Attachments: redwood-tech-evidence-v1.pdf, ami-screenshot-20270607.png, co-sell-playbook-draft.docx

Thanks,
Aisha Rahman
Senior Partnerships Manager, Redwood Inference

On Mon, Jun 7, 2027 at 10:03 AM Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Suggested AWS product page blurb (first pass):
> Redwood Inference — high-throughput LLM inference platform for predictable latency and cost.
> Top bullets:
> - Hosted API, Dedicated pools, and VPC/private deployment options
> - Transparent performance & token-level cost breakdowns
> - Built-in rollout and fallback policies for reliability

Thanks Aisha — quick copy edits from UX/marketplace POV:
- One-liner: make it benefit-first and avoid jargon. Suggest: "Run production-grade LLM inference with predictable latency, lower token cost, and enterprise controls."
- Bullets: reorder for customer impact and tighten language: 
  * Production-grade inference: predictable latency, autoscaling Dedicated pools
  * Cost controls: token-level billing, batching & caching optimizations
  * Security & deployment: Hosted, Dedicated, and VPC/private options with KMS/HSM support

Footnote suggestion for the product page: add a small eligibility line for Private Offer buyers ("Private Offer available for enterprise contracts and dedicated capacity").

Also, for the co-sell playbook: remove the internal-only notes from page 2 (we should supply a clean customer-facing 1-pager). Ben — do you want me to cut the 20-min script to a 12-min demo that highlights the deployment story?

-Kim
Kimberly Park
Head of Marketplace & GTM, Redwood Inference

- redwood-tech-evidence-v1.pdf: SOC 2 summary, data flow diagrams (hosted/dedicated), KMS/HSM notes, seller-id + AMI guidance

Links: DocuSign for our standard co-sell MOU: https://app.docusign.com/rdw/acme-cosell-mou. Please sign so we can enable co-sell tracking in HubSpot and route deal registration on the AWS side.

Next steps:

- I'll book a 30-min field enablement session Fri 6/11 10:00am PT unless you prefer a different slot
- Ben/Marissa/Kim: final follow-ups on demo script and product copy (I've incorporated Kim's edits into the attached playbook)

Let me know if you need any additional evidence (full SOC 2 report, penetration test report) — we can provide redacted copies under NDA.
